answer_1.quote: Abstractive text summarization takes one or more documents as input and aims at generating an accurate and coherent summary from it.
answer_1.outputs: coherent output text encompassing only the information provided within those highlights

answer_2.quote: To measure content preservation we apply the metric between the generated text and the highlighted content aimed to be preserved (technically, the highlights are concatenated to apply the ROUGE measure).

answer_4.quote: We leverage different summarization datasets to annotate a high-quality dataset for the evaluation of controlled-reduction systems.
answer_4.guideline: We provide guidelines for the annotator to break up the summary sentence into the facts that it is comprised of.
